(a) WHAT FAILED: the page build, not Ghost. publish-deals-page.ps1 has three rc-1 exits: 156 (build-deals-page rc != 0), 157 (embed missing/short) and 294 (Ghost upsert rc != 0). A 25 s run is shorter than that morning's build alone (26.8 s) and the timing table is printed only at the end, so the run died inside or just after the build, before the Ghost leg. Commit 201fadc9a (18:09:35) states it: 'Guards then passed (hard=0 warn=19) and the publish still failed, at build-deals-page: one recipe row, boneless-pork-chops, had no category ... build-deals-page renders recipe rows into categories.json's sections and THROWS on any row it cannot place'. THE REASON IS NOT IN THE LOG: check-ad-cycles.ps1:1423-1432 captures publish-deals-page's stdout into $pubOut and logs only lines matching the timing-table shape ('publish-deals-page timings' or four-space stage lines); the 'ERROR: page build FAILED (rc=N) - not publishing' line the script printed was discarded. local-daily-log.txt has no 17:2x entry. (b) RETRY: not proposed. The Ghost leg did not run. It is publish-resource.ps1: Invoke-GhostApi GET posts/slug/<slug> then create-or-update (lines 46, 52), so its create branch is a POST; lib/ghost-lib.ps1's header (backlog I198, 2026-09-19) records per HTTP method that a replayed POST is not idempotent. The change gate (publish-deals-page.ps1:262-275, Test-UpsertNeeded, 'fail toward doing the work') already makes the NEXT RUN the safe retry: a failed upsert leaves out/deals-page.sig unstamped (296-298) so the next chain run republishes.

The comment above it (1578-1581, queue 2026-09-07-e9edb9) records that this line 'USED TO LIE' when it printed unconditionally after 'GUARDS FAILED' on 2026-09-07 (and 2026-09-03 08:09:18 shows the same pair); that fix added the HELD branch and left the publish outcome unread, so rc 1 (this run) and rc 2 (coverage HELD, line 1434) both print 'the board, the feed and the cards are published'. $pubrc is set at 1424 inside the board-changed block and never read after 1439.

Occurrences of the lying summary on a publish-outcome branch: 1 in the whole ad-cycle-log (AUTO-PUBLISH ERROR/HELD lines followed by the 'published' summary: exactly this one); the guards branch lied twice before its 09-07 fix.
